'''Charnagus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] working for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a base of operations on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] beneath the [[Club Ufora]], where Republic Navy personnel on leave would be drugged and provided to Charnagus as test subjects. The doctor would then remove the subjects' faces and graft them onto Imperial saboteurs in order for them to take Republic officers' place on their ships. Charnagus' operations was eventually brought down after the [[Evocii]] [[Ilox]] noticed that fewer officers were leaving Club Ufora than entering it.
